# Fenced examples

The outer example uses a four-backtick fence so its content can contain a nested-looking triple-backtick sequence without ending the block. This is documentation about a parser boundary, not a request to rewrite the sample code or reinterpret its delimiters. The description includes Unicode text such as 入れ子 and escaped punctuation \[sample\] to make source positions observable.

````markdown
```text
literal **markers** stay in the example
```
````

After the example, this paragraph remains ordinary Markdown.
